caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 8 and operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy. No assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys. This validation entry is a non-security relevant modification to Cert. #2792.
description: The RapidIdentity FIPS Cryptographic Module for Windows is a cryptographic engine for Windows Server. The module delivers core cryptographic functions to Identity Automation’s RapidIdentity MFA server, providing a multitude of authentication methods. The RapidIdentity FIPS Cryptographic Module leverages industry leading, FIPS approved cryptographic algorithms provided by the Bouncy Castle FIPS .NET and Java APIs.
